text:
jamie: Quick idea—can we add a compact set of deploy-bot aliases for fast rollouts and emergency rollback? e.g. one-liners for canary/quick-pin/abort. Keeping change-window prompts too. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: [auto] I can add aliases. Examples: `/deploy start --canary` etc. Will need approved templates.

kai: love this. what would the UX be? single flag like `--fast` that expands?

priya: +1. also add `--chgw` to attach change window metadata. we currently copy/paste.

sre-liz: need explicit safety checks: preflight lint, service health gates, and a `--force` opt-in for emergency rollbacks. maybe `--abort` maps to rollback.

marta: I can prototype a bash wrapper that expands aliases to full deploy commands and opens a modal for change window details.

nora: if we can auto-generate release notes from the git commit range when `--notes` present, that'd cut manual work.

kai: sketch of alias file:
```
# ~/.deploy_aliases
fast_deploy: deploy --pin latest --canary=10% --wait-health
quick_abort: deploy rollback --to-last-successful --skip-approval
chgw: deploy annotate --change-window "${WINDOW}" --owner ${USER}
```

priya: Also surface token/cost estimate with `--est` before confirming. small UX win. :money_with_wings:

jamie: good. needs tests and a rollforward plan. can we add `--dry-run` output that prints the expanded commands for ops review?

deploy-bot: Implemented prototype commands in `release-sherpa` branch. Run:
```
/release-sherpa fast --notes --chgw "2024-06-01 22:00-22:30 UTC" --dry-run
```
Will print plan and require `confirm` to execute.

sre-liz: make sure `--dry-run` includes health check queries and the exact k8s diff. no surprises.

marta: I'll open a PR with the wrapper + unit tests. tagging @kai & @priya for review.

nora: can we add a tiny generator for release notes: `--notes=commits|changelog` to choose source?

jamie: yep. PR link when ready. after review we'll add to the deploy-bot help and update runbook. :shipit:

priya: leaving a checklist here: 1) alias spec 2) dry-run output 3) change-window modal 4) notes generator 5) tests 6) doc snippets. i'll take doc snippets.

marta: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-sherpa/compare (WIP)

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled change window template available at /templates/change-window. Use `--chgw-template` to prefill.

kai: nifty. if we can land this before the next week-long change freeze, that'd be ideal.

jamie: agreed. timeline: prototype this week, PR review early next, roll out to staging for one deploy test.

sre-liz: if we need emergency rollback drills, count me in.

nora: added to release playbook draft.
